title: Maharasan
desc: Selvi falls in love with Vadivelu, a butcher. Realising that Vadivelu has to get his sister married first, Selvi helps him find an ideal life partner for his sister.

title: Vishwa Thulasi
desc: Thulasi returns home to teach dance in her village. She thinks of her love Vishwa, but memories of her cousin's obsession trouble her.

title: Mudhal Mariyadhai
desc: A middle-aged upper-caste man, Malaichami, leads an unhappy married life but seeks comfort in a new friendship with a low-caste woman. However, their friendship leads to many rumours in their village.

title: Sivasakthi
desc: Sakthi, a police officer, befriends Siva, a smuggler, in order to gain his trust and get evidence against him. But soon, their friendship turns into a genuine one.

title: Unnidathil Ennai Koduthen
desc: Selvam and Bhaskar, two thieves with good intentions, hide with the help of Radha who is an illegitimate child living with his father's family in the guise of a maid.
